svg.title: Game loop: read input, move everything, check collisions, draw
svg.text: What the game does about 60 times every second
W A S D, arrows, mouse clicks
3D world first, then HUD on top
Everything moves by speed x time passed (dt) so the game runs at the same
speed on a fast or a slow computer.
